collection_complete_formula: collection_complete = all primaries accounted AND policy_violations empty AND (usable >= target OR valid exhaustion); this supersedes the v6.2 wording, which omitted the exhaustion clause
defect_corrected: the analyzer accepted --responses-frozen in a non-terminal collection state (under target with unused replacement slots remaining), allowing a premature freeze to bypass the frozen replacement procedure and reach a no-authority verdict; separately, commit fa6f2e9 extended the v6.2 collection_complete formula with an exhaustion clause AFTER v6.2 was frozen instead of amending prospectively - that extension is ratified here and its post-hoc introduction is disclosed
execution_binding: this amendment becomes the manifest-bound amendment: the builder validates its schema and chain (v6.2 digest, protocol, power-v1) and embeds THIS file's digest in bundle-manifest.json amendment_sha256; QC and analyzer verify the supplied amendment file against the manifest exactly as before
qc_accounting_parity: the QC status table lists absent-row withdrawn/duplicate scheduled slots as excluded (matching the analyzer's exclusion report) so blinded operational accounting and final analysis accounting are consistent
terminal_state_rule: authoritative analysis (and therefore response freezing) is permitted ONLY in a terminal collection state: (a) usable judgments from included submitted sessions >= target, or (b) every replacement slot R30-R35 is accounted for (submitted session or withdrawn/duplicate entry) while usable remains below target - valid exhaustion, which authorizes freezing SOLELY for the no-authority-insufficient-usable-judgments verdict; in any other state the analyzer hard-errors and collection must continue
title: Terminal-state enforcement for response freezing; exhaustion clarification
